facts.title: roasted leek and white bean galettes
ingredients: 8 tablespoons (4 ounces or 115 grams) cold unsalted butter, cut into pieces and chill again
1/4 cup (60 grams) plain yogurt or sour cream
6 small-to-medium leeks, dark green tops discarded, white and light green parts halved lengthwise
1 15-ounce can cannellini beans, rinsed and drained
1 egg yolk beaten with 1 teaspoon water
facts.author: Deb Perelman
